name: power-quiz
description: Live pixel-kart quiz races: leads run quizzes on a big screen, players join from their phones.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @power-quiz/server" "npm run dev -w @power-quiz/web"
scripts.dev:lan: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @power-quiz/server" "npm run dev -w @power-quiz/web -- --host"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @power-quiz/web && npm run build -w @power-quiz/server && node scripts/package-deploy.mjs
